text: 进入国庆黄金周，上海楼市迎来“银十”开门红。不少新盘项目抢抓假期窗口开放展厅、推出专属特价房源吸引客户。叠加天气转晴、假期末尾返沪人流增多，不少新房项目的到访、成交迎来一波小高峰，二手房带看与议价氛围也同步回暖。位于闵行区浦江镇的象屿·天宸雅颂项目，国庆假期售楼处客流热度不减。据项目负责人介绍，国庆期间项目推出特价房活动，房源去化表现较好。截至10月4日，假期累计到访客户接近170组。
text_en: As the National Day Golden Week began, Shanghai's property market got off to a strong start for the 'Silver October.' Many new projects seized the holiday window to open showrooms and launch exclusive discounted units to attract customers. Combined with clearer weather and more people returning to Shanghai at the end of the holiday, many new home projects saw a small peak in visits and transactions, and the atmosphere for second-hand home viewings and negotiations also warmed in tandem. At the Xiangyu Tianchen Yayue project in Pujiang Town, Minhang District, sales office traffic remained strong during the National Day holiday. According to the project manager, special discounted housing activities were launched during the holiday, and unit sell-through performed well. As of October 4, cumulative customer visits during the holiday approached 170 groups.
